title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
summary: CISA has added two new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE(s) Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Directory or Path Traversal Vulnerability CVE(s) LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following Vulnerability These types of vulnerabilities are a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise.
